_comment: Nova's render settings and per-object properties for Solaris (docs/design/M4.md 3.7): the one table gen_nova_ds.py turns into soho/parameters/HdNovaRendererPlugin_{Global,Geometry,Viewport}.ds and build_nova_hdas.py into the Nova Render Settings LOP. scopes: global = a render setting (Render Settings LOP), viewport = also in the viewport's display options, geometry = also a constant primvar per prim (Render Geometry Settings LOP, primvars:<key>). types: int, float, bool, token (with a menu), string, color (three floats, a color3f in USD); a menu on an int or a string lists its values, menutype: replace makes it fill a field that takes any text. Defaults must equal the delegate's descriptors (hydra/renderDelegate.cpp); tests/houdini/test_solaris_ui.py checks it. hda: false keeps a global setting out of what the Nova LOPs author (it stays on the Nova tab of the Render Settings LOP).

settings.label: Samples
settings.help: Samples per pixel. Unset: Karma's samples (Path Traced: pathtracedsamples; Variance and Distributed: samplesperpixel times varianceaa_maxsamples).

settings.label: Sample Scale
settings.help: Multiplies the samples per pixel, Nova's or Karma's; at least one sample remains. 0.25 previews a scene that is set up for its final quality at a quarter of the render time.

settings.label: Pixel Filter
settings.help: The pixel reconstruction filter. Unset: Karma's pixelfilter.

settings.label: Pixel Filter Scale
settings.help: Multiplies the filter's width (0: point sampling). Unset: Karma's pixelfilterscale.

settings.label: Seed
settings.help: Varies the sample pattern between renders of the same frame. Unset: Karma's randomseed.

settings.label: Animate Noise
settings.help: Every frame has a noise pattern of its own (husk hands each frame its number, as it does for Karma). Off: every frame has the pattern of the Seed, so the noise stands still on the screen while the picture moves under it; two renders of different frames then differ only by what moved.

settings.label: Time Limit
settings.help: Ends a frame after this many minutes of rendering with the samples it has by then: the image is denoised and written as when all samples are done, and the render statistics say how many samples it got (0: no limit). The limit is checked between passes, so a frame overruns it by at most one pass. Final renders only; the viewport renders on.

settings.label: Clamp Indirect
settings.help: Clamps indirect light per sample against fireflies (0: off). Unset (and Clamp Direct unset): Karma's colour limits (colorlimit for what the camera sees and the first hit gathers, colorlimitindirect for the rest, emission found by the first bounce counting as indirect).

settings.label: Clamp Direct
settings.help: Clamps per sample what the camera sees directly and the light the first hit gathers (0: off).

settings.label: Device
settings.help: Where Nova renders: on the CPU, or on an NVIDIA GPU with OptiX (XPU; the CPU takes over when no GPU is usable). Unset, each renderer uses its own: Nova the CPU, Nova XPU the GPU. The Rendering Engine menu of the Nova LOPs picks the renderer instead.

settings.label: Threads
settings.help: The CPU threads Nova renders with. 0: all the host allows (husk's -j, Houdini's own limit). A positive number: at most that many. A negative number: that many fewer than all, which keeps the machine usable while it renders. With Nova XPU these are the threads that prepare the scene and that render when the GPU cannot.

settings.label: Max Ray Depth
settings.help: A safety cap on the scattering events of a path; the per-type limits decide the look.

settings.label: Russian Roulette Depth
settings.help: From this scattering event on, paths that carry little light are ended by chance and the survivors weighted up: the image stays the same, deep bounces cost less and get a little noisier. Higher values keep more paths alive (less noise in deep indirect light and in many layers of glass, longer renders); a value above Max Ray Depth turns the roulette off.

settings.label: Diffuse Limit
settings.help: Diffuse bounces (fractions dither between the neighbouring integers). Past the limit, rays only collect light. Unset: Karma's diffuselimit.

settings.label: Reflection Limit
settings.help: Glossy and mirror reflection bounces. Unset: Karma's reflectlimit.

settings.label: Refraction Limit
settings.help: Refraction bounces. Unset: Karma's refractlimit.

settings.label: SSS Limit
settings.help: Subsurface and translucency bounces. Unset: Karma's ssslimit.

settings.label: Volume Limit
settings.help: Volume scattering events. Unset: Karma's volumelimit.

settings.label: Thin Walls at the Refraction Limit
settings.help: Past the refraction limit (up to twice it), refractions continue straight on instead of stopping. Unset: Karma's thinwallatrefractlimit.

settings.label: Default Material
settings.help: What geometry without a material renders as. As Karma: Karma's own default, Houdini's plastic (it reflects 0.4 of the display colour diffusely, with a soft highlight; white where there is no display colour). Matte Display Color: a matte surface that reflects the display colour itself (18 % grey where there is none), as Nova rendered up to 0.1.6.

settings.label: Fake Caustics
settings.help: Shadows and diffuse rays pass through this object's transmission (transparent shadows) instead of needing caustic paths. Unset: Karma's causticsenable inverted, with Karma's shadow factor and its fake-caustics controls; Karma's render settings fake caustics by default.

settings.label: Caustics Roughness Clamp
settings.help: The least roughness of glossy and refracting surfaces seen after a diffuse bounce (true caustics only): softer, less noisy caustics. Unset: Karma's causticsroughnessclamp (0.2 with Karma's render settings).

settings.label: Internal Reflection
settings.help: Refracting surfaces reflect on their inside too. Off: light inside a solid dielectric leaves it without Fresnel loss and only total internal reflection sends it back in. Unset: Karma's internalreflectenable (off with Karma's render settings).

settings.label: Dielectric Priority
settings.help: Where refracting objects overlap (liquid in a glass, ice in the liquid), the inside belongs to the one with the highest priority: 0 is the highest, larger numbers lose. Surfaces of lower priority inside a higher one are passed through unseen; the others bend light by the ratio of the indices on both sides. Equal priorities nest nothing. Unset: Karma's dielectricpriority.

settings.label: Constrain by Maximum Roughness
settings.help: Glossy surfaces along a path are at least as rough as the roughest glossy bounce before them (fewer fireflies from sharp reflections seen in blurry ones). Unset: Karma's constrainmaxrough (on with Karma's render settings).

settings.label: Light Override
settings.help: Replaces the stage's lights: Emissive Objects leaves only emissive geometry, Headlight lights along the camera's view, Dome Light is a white dome. Neither the headlight nor the dome is seen by the camera. Unset: Karma's override_lighting.

settings.label: Headlight Without Lights
settings.help: Lights a stage that has no light with a headlight (emissive geometry does not count as a light). Unset: Karma's autoheadlight.

settings.label: Simplified Shading
settings.help: Shades what the camera sees with its display colour (white without one) by how much it faces the camera, darkened by ambient occlusion, with the fog below and the material's emission: no lights, no bounces. A fast look at a heavy scene's shapes. Unset: Karma's Simplified Shading (disable_lighting).

settings.label: Ambient Occlusion
settings.help: Simplified Shading darkens corners and contact areas. Unset: Karma's head_ao_samples (0 is off).

settings.label: Ambient Occlusion Distance
settings.help: How far away a surface may be to occlude, in scene units (0: at any distance). Unset: Karma's head_ao_distance.

settings.label: Fog Near
settings.help: Simplified Shading mixes the Fog Color in by distance: none up to here, all of it from Fog Far on. Unset (both): Karma's head_depthcue_z.

settings.label: Fog Far
settings.help: The distance from which the fog is full (no fog while it is not beyond Fog Near).

settings.label: Fog Color
settings.help: The colour distant surfaces fade to. Unset: Karma's head_depthcue_color.

settings.label: Fog Alpha
settings.help: The most fog that is mixed in. Unset: Karma's head_depthcue_alpha.

settings.label: Outlines
settings.help: Toon lines where the camera sees an object's silhouette, a crease or a step in depth (the line types are per-object properties). With this switch the lines are drawn into the beauty whether or not the render has an outline AOV. Unset: Karma's outline_enable, which draws lines only in renders with an outline AOV.

settings.label: Outline Color
settings.help: The lines' colour (Karma's default). Unset: Karma's outline_color.

settings.label: Outline Radius
settings.help: Multiplies the objects' line widths. Unset: Karma's outline_radius.

settings.label: Outline Intensity
settings.help: Scales the lines' weight. Unset: Karma's outline_intensity.

settings.label: Outline Fit Min
settings.help: The share of a pixel's edge probes that find an edge is remapped from Fit Min..Fit Max to 0..1: raising the minimum removes faint lines, lowering the maximum hardens the lines' edges. Unset: Karma's outline_fitmin.

settings.label: Outline Fit Max
settings.help: See Outline Fit Min. Unset: Karma's outline_fitmax.

settings.label: Outline Depth Threshold Scale
settings.help: Multiplies the objects' depth thresholds (how large a step in depth draws a line). Unset: Karma's outline_depththreshold.

settings.label: Outline Depth Blend
settings.help: 0: lines keep their width on screen at any distance. 1: they thin out with distance, as lines of a fixed width in the scene do. Unset: Karma's outline_depthblend.

settings.label: Outline Samples
settings.help: The edge probes per camera sample (on the first ring; each further ring has twice as many). Unset: Karma's outline_primary_samples.

settings.label: Outline Rings
settings.help: The rings of edge probes around a camera ray: more rings give lines a softer profile. Unset: Karma's outline_primary_stencils.

settings.label: Outline Pattern
settings.help: Where the edge probes lie: on rings, or scattered at random inside the radius (Outline Samples of them). Unset: Karma's outline_mode.

settings.label: Outlines in the Beauty
settings.help: Draws the lines into the beauty. Off: they are in the outline AOVs only. Unset: Karma's outline_apply.

settings.label: Draw Outlines
settings.help: The object gets lines where the camera sees it (with Outlines on in the render settings). Unset: Karma's outline_enable of the object.

settings.label: Line Radius
settings.help: The lines' width on this object: the tangent of the angle around a camera ray in which edges are looked for, so a line is as wide on screen near and far (see Outline Depth Blend). Unset: Karma's outline_radius of the object.

settings.label: Contour Lines
settings.help: Lines along the object's silhouette: where the next thing seen is another object, or nothing. Unset: Karma's outline_contour.

settings.label: Crease Lines
settings.help: Lines where the surface folds. Unset: Karma's outline_crease.

settings.label: Crease Threshold
settings.help: How far the normal must turn for a crease line: 1 minus the cosine of the angle (0.1 is 26 degrees, 1 a right angle). Unset: Karma's outline_creasethreshold.

settings.label: Depth Lines
settings.help: Lines where the object steps back behind itself. Unset: Karma's outline_depth.

settings.label: Depth Threshold
settings.help: How large a step in depth draws a line: 1 plus the threshold, times the line's radius at the surface (0: a step of one radius, 1: of two). Unset: Karma's outline_depththreshold of the object.

settings.label: LPE Tag
settings.help: The object's tag in light path expressions, as the LPE tag of a light or of a material: <L.'key'> is the light of the emissive objects tagged key. Unset: Karma's lpetag.

settings.label: Render Visibility
menu: Visible Only to Primary and Shadow Rays
settings.help: The rays that see the object, in Karma's syntax: the ray types primary, shadow, diffuse, reflect, refract, volume and sss, * for all, a leading - for all but, & and | to combine. "-primary" hides an object from the camera while it still shadows and reflects; an empty value hides it from every ray. Unset: Karma's rendervisibility.

settings.label: Holdout Mode
settings.help: Matte: the object is cut out of the image (colour and alpha 0 where the camera sees it) and still shadows and reflects. Background: a stand-in for the plate, whose alpha is the shadow the other objects cast on it. Unset: Karma's holdoutmode.

settings.label: Background Holdouts Occlude Shadows
settings.help: Background holdouts never shadow one another (the plate has those shadows already). With this on, a point of a background holdout that another background holdout hides from a light keeps that light even where an ordinary object shadows it too. Unset: Karma's bgoccludeshadow.

settings.label: Efficient Emission Sampling
settings.help: Treats an emissive mesh or volume as a light source: its emission is light-sampled (much less noise on what it lights) and is a light (L) in light path expressions, also for the camera. Yes and Auto both treat the parts whose material emits. Moving meshes and VEX materials stay plain emitters. Unset: Karma's treat_as_lightsource, whose light multipliers (lightsource_diffusescale and specularscale) Nova reads as well.

settings.label: Is Portal
settings.help: The mesh becomes a light portal: it renders nothing, and the dome lights it serves shine only through their portals (light from directions that pass no portal is shut out, as in Karma), sampled through them: much less noise in interiors lit through windows. Cover every opening a dome should light through. Unset: Karma's isportal.

settings.label: Portal Dome Lights
settings.help: The dome lights the portal serves: their paths, separated by spaces, with * and ? wildcards (* serves every dome light). Unset: Karma's portaldomelights.

settings.label: Curve Style
settings.help: How curves render: flat ribbons turned towards each ray, round tubes (normals ignored), ribbons facing their normals, or ribbons where the curves have normals and tubes elsewhere. Linear curves cannot be oriented and face the ray. Unset: Karma's curve_style.

settings.label: Width Scale
settings.help: Multiplies the widths of curves and points. Unset: Karma's width_scale.

settings.label: Point Style
settings.help: How points render: discs turned towards each ray, spheres, or discs facing the points' normals (facing the ray where there are none). Unset: Karma's point_style.

settings.label: Velocity Blur
settings.help: Motion blur of meshes, curves and points from their velocities (v in SOPs, units per second) instead of their time samples, for geometry whose point count changes from frame to frame. Velocity Blur moves the points in straight lines over the shutter; Acceleration Blur bends the paths with the accelerations (accel), sampled Acceleration Samples times. Volumes blur by their velocity field when this is on (both modes move them linearly; Karma's volumevblurscale scales it). Unset: Karma's vblur (on the object, else on the render settings).

settings.label: Instance Velocity Blur
settings.help: Set on a point instancer: its instances move with the instancer's velocities and turn with its angular velocities instead of following the time samples of their positions and orientations; Acceleration Blur adds the accelerations. Unset: Karma's instance_vblur (on the instancer, else on the render settings).

settings.label: Acceleration Samples
settings.help: How many times Acceleration Blur samples the shutter (Max Motion Steps caps it); 2 is a straight line from shutter open to close. Unset: Karma's geosamples, on point instancers its instance_samples.

settings.label: Max Motion Steps
settings.help: The most shutter samples of moving geometry, transforms and cameras.

settings.label: Pixel Oracle
settings.help: Uniform renders Samples in every pixel. Variance stops each pixel once its noise is below the Noise Threshold (adaptive sampling); Samples is then the maximum. Unset: with Karma's samples, Karma's pixel oracle (always Variance in Karma's Variance mode).

settings.label: Minimum Samples
settings.help: Samples every pixel gets before the variance oracle may stop it (rounded up to a power of two). -1: max(16, square root of Samples). Unset: with Karma's samples, from Karma's minrays and varianceaa_minsamples.

settings.label: Noise Threshold
settings.help: The variance oracle's noise level: smaller values render more samples (0.01 is about the quality of 90 uniform samples on a Cornell box). Unset: with Karma's samples, Karma's variance threshold.

settings.label: Enable Indirect Guiding
settings.help: Path guiding: Nova learns from the first samples where indirect light comes from and sends more indirect rays there, on the CPU and the GPU. The image stays the same; its noise drops where indirect light comes from small or hidden parts of the scene (a room lit through a window, light behind a wall), and the renders stay deterministic. Unset: Karma's guiding_enable.

settings.label: Indirect Training Samples
settings.help: The samples per pixel that keep improving what guiding learned; the rest of the render uses it as it is then. 0: learn throughout the render. Unset: Karma's guiding_samples (primary samples: with Karma's Variance or Distributed sampling, times the maximum secondary samples).

settings.label: Indirect Guiding Components
settings.help: The kinds of scattering that guiding steers, by their names: diffuse, reflect, coat, refract, volume, sss. Unset: Karma's guiding_components.

settings.label: Indirect Guiding Render from Scratch Post-Training
settings.help: Drops the training samples from the image when training ends (Indirect Training Samples above 0); the render still takes Samples in all. Unset: Karma's guiding_clearbuffers.

settings.label: Denoise
settings.help: Denoises the final frame (husk, nova_cli) with the Denoiser below: the AOVs of Denoised AOVs, in place. The Karma Render Settings LOP's Denoiser works too. Unset: the denoiser of Karma's image filters.

settings.label: Denoiser
settings.help: The denoiser of final frames and of the viewport. Automatic: NVIDIA OptiX where it can run, Intel Open Image Denoise elsewhere (machines without an NVIDIA GPU; it then runs on the CPU). A denoiser that cannot run gives way to the other, with a message. Unset or Automatic: the engine of Karma's Denoiser menu, if it names one.

settings.label: Denoised AOVs
settings.help: The AOVs to denoise (their names, e.g. C directdiffuse); LPE AOVs denoise with the beauty's kernels.

settings.label: Denoise Quality
settings.help: The quality of Intel Open Image Denoise's filter, slower with each step. Automatic: High for final frames, Balanced in the viewport. NVIDIA OptiX has one quality.

settings.label: Denoise with Albedo
settings.help: Hands the denoiser the albedo at the first hit as a guide, which keeps the detail of textures apart from noise. Unset: the Use Albedo switch of Karma's Denoiser for final frames, on in the viewport.

settings.label: Denoise with Normals
settings.help: Hands the denoiser the normal at the first hit as a guide, which keeps edges and bumps; Open Image Denoise uses it only together with the albedo. Unset: the Use N switch of Karma's Denoiser for final frames, on in the viewport.

settings.label: Denoise the Viewport
settings.help: Shows the viewport's image denoised (by the Denoiser of the render settings). Unset: Karma's viewport denoise toggle.

settings.label: Denoise Start Passes
settings.help: The viewport shows the noisy image for the first passes after an edit, then the denoised one.

settings.label: Deep Samples at the Hit Distance
settings.help: The depth of a deep camera map's samples is their distance from the eye instead of their depth along the camera's axis. Unset: Karma's dcm_usehitdist.

settings.label: Deep Without Holdouts
settings.help: Leaves the samples of holdout objects out of the deep camera map. Unset: Karma's dcm_excludeholdouts.

settings.label: IPR Proxy Passes
settings.help: After an edit the viewport first renders one pixel per 4x4, then per 2x2 block, for a fast first image; those samples count towards the image. 0: full passes only. Unset: Karma's ipr_proxydepth.

settings.label: Subdivision Level
settings.help: Uniform subdivision level of subdivision surfaces (-1: from the display complexity).

settings.label: Max Triangles per Mesh
settings.help: Triangle budget of a subdivided or displaced mesh; above it, coarser tessellation and a warning.

settings.label: Dicing Quality Scale
settings.help: Multiplies every object's displacement dicing quality. Unset: Karma's dicingqualityscale.

settings.label: Off-screen Dicing Quality
settings.help: Dicing quality of displaced objects outside the camera's view. Unset: Karma's offscreenquality.

settings.label: Dicing Quality
settings.help: Displacement micropolygons per pixel edge (0.5: 2-pixel micropolygons, Karma's default). Unset: Karma's dicingquality.

settings.label: Dicing Depth
settings.help: A fixed 2^depth segments per edge instead of the camera's rate (-1: off). Unset: Karma's dicingdepthmin and dicingdepthmax when they agree.

settings.label: Displacement
settings.help: Applies the material's displacement. Unset: Karma's truedisplace (off for Disable Displacement Shader).

settings.label: Convert Textures
settings.help: Converts images to tiled, MIP-mapped, linear .tx files in the texture cache directory.

settings.label: Texture Cache Directory
settings.help: Where converted textures go (empty: $HOUDINI_TEMP_DIR/nova_tx).

settings.label: Texture Blur
settings.help: Extra blur of every texture lookup. Unset: Karma's mtlx_imageblur.

settings.label: Texture Filter Width
settings.help: Texture footprint relative to the pixel's ray cone (0.25 as Karma; 0: the finest MIP level). Unset: a quarter of Karma's mtlx_imagewidth.

settings.label: Abort on Missing Texture
settings.help: Stops the render when a texture file cannot be read. Unset: Karma's abortmissingtexture.

settings.label: Texture Statistics
settings.help: OpenImageIO texture statistics level printed at the end of a render.

settings.label: Texture Cache Size
settings.help: The memory of the texture cache on the CPU in MB (0: OpenImageIO's own limit, or what husk's --oiio-* options set). Texture tiles beyond it are dropped and read again when needed: a scene whose textures do not fit renders slower, not wrong. The cache is the process's own, so inside Houdini it is shared with what else reads textures there.

settings.label: GPU Texture Budget
settings.help: The GPU memory for textures with Nova XPU, in MB (0: half the memory free when the first texture loads). When the textures do not fit, the largest are reduced first: every texture is capped at the largest size that fits (all tiles of a UDIM set alike) and only the MIP levels kept are read, with a warning.

settings.label: Light Selection
settings.help: How a light sample picks its light: the light tree weighs every light by how much it can light the point (scenes with many lights render with far less noise); Uniform picks by power alone. Unset: Karma's light_sampling_mode.

settings.label: Light Sampling
settings.help: Debugging aid: which estimators sample direct light.
